title: Why do onions make us cry?
examples: What is in onions that makes us cry?
Do tears help stop the crying?
Is it the smell or the cut that makes it?

explain.say: When you cut an onion, something special happens inside.

draw.text: Why do onions make us cry?

explain.say: This gas is a natural thing that onions make.
These tiny gas bits float into the air around your eyes.
Your eyes have tears that wash away the gas bits.
So, the gas makes your eyes feel stingy, and tears help clean it.
When you smell the gas, it reminds you of the onion's strong smell.

faq.q: Why do onions make us cry?
faq.a: When you cut onions, they release tiny gas bits into the air. These gas bits irritate your eyes, which makes you cry.
asks: Why does cutting them make me cry?

faq.q: Do tears wash the gas away?
faq.a: Yes, your tears are like a natural wash. They help carry the gas away from your eyes, which helps stop the stinging feeling.
asks: Can tears help clean my eyes?

faq.q: Is the smell or the cut that makes us cry?
faq.a: It is the gas that comes out when you cut them. The gas is what floats into your eyes and causes the stinging feeling.
asks: Do I have to cut them?

faq.q: Can we stop the gas from coming out?
faq.a: Some people soak the onions first, or cook them, because this can change the gas they release.
asks: Is there a trick for onions?

faq.q: What is the gas made of?
faq.a: The gas is made from chemicals inside the onion that react when it is cut. These chemicals are what cause the sting.
asks: What is the science behind it?

facts: Onions release sulfur compounds when cut.
These gases are volatile and can float into the air.
Tears help flush these irritating gases away from the eyes.
The gas causes a stinging sensation in the eyes.

quiz.say: When an onion is cut, what is released into the air?
quiz.show: Gas is released when onions are cut.
quiz.why: The process of cutting releases gas from the onion's structure.

wrong.1: Water is what is in the onion, but the gas is what causes the sting.
wrong.2: The smell is caused by the gas, but the gas itself is the physical thing released.
wrong.3: Tears are what come out later to wash the gas away, not what comes out first.

quiz.say: What helps remove the irritating gas from your eyes?
quiz.why: Tears are a natural liquid that flows out to wash away the foreign gas particles.

wrong.0: Rubbing can make the eyes hurt more, and it does not remove the gas properly.
wrong.1: Blinking is good, but the main action of washing away the gas is done by the overall flow of tears.
wrong.3: While air moves things, the liquid tears are needed to physically wash the gas away.

quiz.say: If the gas stings your eyes, what is the main action happening?
quiz.why: The gas molecules are what chemically irritate the sensitive tissues in your eyes.

wrong.1: Tears help wash it, but the gas itself is the initial irritant.
wrong.2: Onions are food, and the gas is only irritating when concentrated near the eyes.
wrong.3: The gas does not just disappear; it needs a liquid like tears to wash it away.
